metadata.title: Geometric Partial Differential Equations of Hydrodynamic Type for Maps into F$_\text{man}$-Lie Groups
metadata.abstract: We develop a geometric framework for partial differential equations of hydrodynamic type on maps from a two-dimensional manifold into an F$_\text{man}$-Lie group. Using the left-invariant structure and the Maurer-Cartan form, we reduce these equations to non-linear evolution systems on the underlying F$_\text{man}$-algebra, governed by its Lie bracket and commutative associative product. We investigate the role of Poisson subalgebras, establishing that flatness of the canonical connection forces two-step nilpotency and yields a linearized evolution equation upon quotienting by the center. Furthermore, we introduce the notion of a Poisson splitting and derive the corresponding tangential and transversal evolution equations. Under suitable reductivity assumptions, we show that their non-linear coupling is governed by the curvature of the canonical principal connection on the homogeneous space $G/H$. These results reveal the interplay between the algebraic structure of F$_\text{man}$-Lie groups and the geometric dynamics of hydrodynamic-type equations.
metadata.comment: 22 pages, comments and questions are very welcome

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 水动力型方程的代数约化
analysis.workSummary: 作者研究二维源流形到F_man–Lie群的水动力型PDE，用左不变结构和Maurer–Cartan形式约化为底层F_man代数上由Lie括号与交换结合乘积控制的非线性演化。分析Poisson子代数，证明相应典范联络平坦迫使两步幂零，按中心取商后得到线性化方程。引入Poisson分裂，并在适当约化性条件下用齐性空间G/H的典范主联络曲率描述切向与横向演化的非线性耦合。
techniques: 约化齐性空间的典范主联络
analysis.breakthrough: 从代数约化中识别线性化的平坦机制，以及横向与切向耦合的曲率来源。
analysis.limitations: 两步幂零与线性化有Poisson子代数和联络平坦性前提，曲率刻画还需适当约化性。摘要主题是方程结构。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。全文原检索和扩展AI名称检索未产生候选。复查正文末尾、参考文献与联系信息，未观察到作者的AI使用披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 连接联络曲率、非线性PDE与Lie代数结构。
